contract.conventions: wind speeds m/s; directionDeg is the compass heading the wind blows toward, matching WorldWind and the sea state; times are presentation seconds unless a field says world

runs.name: freshening
runs.description: The production sea at 6 m/s. After two settled minutes the wind gets up to 14 m/s over five, veering 26 degrees with it, then holds.

runs.name: dying
runs.description: A developed 12.5 m/s sea. After two settled minutes the wind falls away to 4 m/s over five, then holds. The sea has to outlive it.
